title: IBM Security Verify Directory 10.0.0 through 10.0.4 and IBM Verify Directory 11.0.0 does not set the SameSite…
description: IBM Security Verify Directory versions 10.0.0 through 10.0.4 and 11.0.0 do not set the SameSite attribute on session cookies. This omission makes the application vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks, where an attacker could trick authenticated users into sending unauthorized requests. The vulnerability has a low severity score and does not impact confidentiality or availability.
